out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: 1) Hawaiian black lava salt containing activated charcoal was observed at the bar. PIC states that the black salt is used for one of their beverages
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO DISCONTINUE USING THE BLACK LAVA SALT. PIC AGREED AND WILL CONTACT CORPORATE.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed vacuum packaged Raw ground tuna thawing in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CUT OPEN THE BAG WHEN THAWING VACUUM PACKAGED FISH.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed holes in the gray coating on the floor exposing the red tiles throughout the kitchen. Observed gray adhesive on the red tiles along the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPAIR FLOORING TO ENSURE CLEANABLITY AND TO REDUCE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap at the bar hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PLACED HAND SOAP AT THIS HAND SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) a squeeze bottle of pasteurized liquid egg whites at the bar were observed at 47f. Squeeze bottle was observed being stored in a container above ice
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE EGG WHITES.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The handles of the coolers in the kitchen were observed sticky to touch.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. ROUTINE CLEANING OF COOLER HANDLES IS REQUIRED. JINYA RAMEN BAR (Inspection Date: 01/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chemical dish machine at the bar was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE BAR DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED. BRING ALL DISHES AND GLASSWARE TO THE MAIN DISH MACHINE. PIC WILL CALL SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR DISH MACHINE.
